---
title: "ibm_verify_events_raw.mfa_activity"
description: "One row per IBM Verify multi-factor authentication event."
---

Every IBM Verify MFA event: a code sent, or a second factor passed or failed.
Prefer the daily summary,
[`events_mfa_activity`](../ibm_verify_events_transformed/events_mfa_activity.qmd).
That table has one count per factor and result. This one has the user, the
device, and who triggered the event.

`Keywords`: MFA, multi-factor, second factor, OTP, FIDO2, sign-up, email check, raw events

## Provenance

Pulled hourly from IBM Verify by the [streaming
job](https://github.com/cds-snc/canadalogin-reporting-data-pipeline/blob/main/infra/modules/ibm_verify_events_streaming/glue_src/ibm_verify_events_streaming_etl.py).
See [IBM Verify Events](../ibm_verify_events_raw.qmd) for what is hashed and
how to filter by day.

* **Updated**: Hourly
* **Retention**: 3 years
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca)
* **Location**: `s3://<raw-bucket>/ibm_verify_events_raw/mfa_activity/`

## Fields

One row per event.

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| time | string | When the event happened, in UTC (for example, "2026-09-15 00:00:05 UTC") |
| subject | string | Hashed user ID. `""` for sign-up email checks (see Notes) |
| username | string | Hashed username, or "UNKNOWN" |
| mfamethod | string | The factor. One of "SMS OTP", "Email OTP", "Voice OTP", or "FIDO2". The summary table renames these, for example to "sms_otp" |
| result | string | "sent", "success", or "failure" |
| mfadevice | string | Hashed phone number, email address, or FIDO2 device |
| performedby_type | string | What triggered the event, as IBM Verify labels it. "intraservice", "api" (an API client), "user", or null |
| performedby_clientname | string | The API client's name, for "api" events (for example, "GC Sign in API Client"). Otherwise empty |
| realm | string | IBM Verify directory. "cloudIdentityRealm", or "UNKNOWN" |
| origin | string | Hashed client IP address |
| geoip__country_iso_code | string | Country from the IP address, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (for example, "CAN") |
| geoip__country_name | string | Country name from the IP address |
| geoip__region_name | string | Province, territory, or state from the IP address |
| year | string | Partition key. UTC year, for example "2026" |
| month | string | Partition key. UTC month, for example "09" |
| day | string | Partition key. UTC day of the month, for example "15" |

## Notes

**Sign-up email checks have no user.** `Email OTP` events with
`performedby_type = "api"` come from "GC Sign in API Client" and never carry a
`subject`. They appear to be the email check during sign-up, before the account
exists. In September 2026 they were 68,000 of 72,350 Email OTP "sent" events.
The summary table counts them in `email_otp`, which is why `email_otp` is not a
sign-in factor.

**OTP factors log a "sent" event too.** See
[`events_mfa_activity`](../ibm_verify_events_transformed/events_mfa_activity.qmd#notes)
for how to count usage and success rates.

**Example.** Distinct users who passed each factor on an ET day:

```r
tbl(con, in_schema("ibm_verify_events_raw", "mfa_activity")) |>
  # partitions are UTC days, so read the next one too for the ET evening
  filter(year == "2026", month == "09", day %in% c("15", "16")) |>
  mutate(et_day = sql("date(with_timezone(CAST(substr(time, 1, 19) AS timestamp), 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto')")) |>
  filter(
    et_day == as.Date("2026-09-15"), result == "success",
    !is.na(subject), !subject %in% c("", "UNKNOWN")
  ) |>
  group_by(mfamethod) |>
  summarise(unique_users = n_distinct(subject))
```
